name: kaoyan-math-2.0
description: 考研数学真题研习平台，支持本地运行与 Cloudflare Workers 部署

scripts.prepare:data: node scripts/prepare-politics.cjs && node scripts/prepare-english.cjs && node scripts/prepare-math.cjs
scripts.build:ui: npm run prepare:data && tsc -p apps/politics/tsconfig.json && vite build --config apps/politics/vite.config.mts && tsc -p apps/english/tsconfig.json && vite build --config apps/english/vite.config.mts
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:unit
